# Fast YouTube Channel Scraper

The Apify actor [`streamers/youtube-channel-scraper`](https://apify.com/streamers/youtube-channel-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.252**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

This alternative YouTube Data API has no limits or quotas. Use it to scrape one or multiple YouTube channels: channel info, URL, total number of subscribers, videos and views, creation date. Try it and get basic video data. You can download extracted data in JSON, CSV, and Excel.

## Pricing

Pay per event — video $0.0013 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/streamers/youtube-channel-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/streamers-youtube-channel-scraper@0.0.252#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Direct URLs — Enter a link to a channel (https://www.youtube.com/c/Apify). You can also import a CSV file or Google Sheet with a list of URLs. |
| `maxResults` | integer |  | `0` | Maximum videos per search term — Limit the number of regular videos (not streams, not shorts) you want to get from one channel. If you use several urls on the input you will get this number for each channel. |
| `maxResultsShorts` | integer |  | `0` | Maximum shorts per search term — Limit the number of Shorts videos you want to get from the channel. |
| `maxResultStreams` | integer |  | `0` | Maximum streams per search term — Limit the number of Stream videos you want to get from the channel. |
| `oldestPostDate` | string |  |  | Scrape videos published after [date] — Only posts uploaded after or on this date will be scraped. Alternatively, specify how old the scraped videos should be in days. Putting 1 day will get you only today's posts, 2 days - yesterday's and today's, and so on. Note, that if you select this, sorting pa |
| `sortVideosBy` | string |  |  | Sort by — Maps to the sorting buttons on the top of the channel's 'Videos', 'Shorts' and 'Live' pages. |
